1:5: But I fear that, just as the queen of the South, who came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon (Matt. 12), will judge the men of her time, and the men of Nineveh, who did penance at the preaching of Jonah, will condemn those who scorned to hear the Savior, greater than Jonah, so very many among the peoples may judge the bishops, withdrawing themselves from the ecclesiastical rank and practicing what does not befit a bishop. …
